name: Hierarchical Wavelet Transform on Omnitrees
definition: A compression strategy that transforms nodal omnitree data into wavelet coefficients to enable lossless or lossy compression via pruning and tree restructuring (downsplit).
summary: Hierarchical Wavelet Transform on Omnitrees converts omnitree data into wavelet coefficients for compression, uniquely operating on the structure's anisotropic layout to allow dimension-specific coarsening.
